descrizione: Ultra-fine, highly refined flour with low ash content, ideal for silky, delicate doughs and classic Neapolitan pizza.
caratteristiche: Very smooth handling and dough formation
uso: Neapolitan pizza, fresh pasta, light pastries
procedimento: Best for recipes requiring a fine, smooth texture and quick high-heat baking.

descrizione: Slightly less refined flour with moderate ash content, highly versatile for balanced dough elasticity and strength.
uso: Bread, focaccia, traditional Roman and tray pizzas
procedimento: Ideal for doughs needing a solid balance between gas-retaining gluten structure and lightness.

descrizione: Stone-ground or partially sifted flour with higher mineral and germ content, delivering superior flavor and robust crust.
caratteristiche: High gluten tenacity and water absorption
Rich rustic grain aroma and color
uso: Rustic sourdough bread, contemporary pizza, high-hydration pans
procedimento: Perfect for recipes requiring deep grain complexity, extra water absorption, and extended maturation.

descrizione: Coarser flour containing substantial bran and germ particles, ideal for deeply flavorful, artisanal baked goods.
uso: Artisan country breads, rustic focaccias, whole-grain pizza blends
procedimento: Use autolyse to soften bran flakes and develop optimum elasticity before adding yeast and salt.

descrizione: Complete grain flour containing 100% of the bran, endosperm, and germ, packed with minerals, vitamins, and intense rustic aroma.
caratteristiche: Nutty, earthy, and toasted flavor profile
High satiety and lower glycemic index
uso: Whole grain bread, health-focused pizza crusts, ancient grain blends
procedimento: Blend with 50-70% strong white flour or use prolonged autolyse for an airy, open whole-grain crumb.
